---
title: Exercises
---

Each week has one exercise page with two parts:

- **Reproduce:** work through a chapter of [Tidy Finance](https://www.tidy-finance.org) or a paper, in R or Python. Try the tasks on your own before you read the solutions, which are in the book chapter or on the page.
- **Open question:** a question without a fixed solution, close to the current lecture. You submit a figure or a number, and the next lecture discusses the results of the whole class.

The exercise classes are open: bring your questions and discuss them with your peers and the TA. You can also post on Absalon or come to my office hours. Grolemund and Wickham's [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) is a good reference for the R basics.

The exercise sets partially subsume work I created with my colleagues Christoph Scheuch and Patrick Weiss for the books *Tidy Finance with R* and *Tidy Finance with Python* ([tidy-finance.org](https://www.tidy-finance.org)). Feedback on *every* aspect is very welcome: if you spot typos, mistakes, or anything that deserves more attention, contact me or my colleagues at [contact@tidy-finance.org](mailto:contact@tidy-finance.org).
